# The compiled files the downloadable app may contain, and the component of
# THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt that credits each.
#
# After building, the release workflow runs tools/check_bundle.py, which
# fails if any compiled file in the bundle (an executable, a shared library
# or a Python extension module) matches no line here. Add a line only once
# the notices credit the file, and check its license first: for Qt, that
# The Qt Company offers the module under the LGPL-3.0.
#
# Each line: the component, as the notices name it, then a pattern for the
# file's path inside the bundle folder (ins_sim/). Patterns match without
# regard to case; * stays within one folder, ** spans folders, {a,b} lists
# alternatives. The first matching line wins.

# The launcher: PyInstaller's bootloader
PyInstaller  ins_sim{,.exe}

# Qt, by module. These are the modules the app needs (with the platform
# libraries Qt loads on Linux), all offered under the LGPL-3.0. Qt Charts,
# Data Visualization, Graphs, Quick 3D, Quick Timeline, Virtual Keyboard and
# Wayland Compositor are offered only under the GPL-3.0 and must not ship.
Qt  _internal/PySide6/Qt6{Core,Gui,Network,OpenGL,Pdf,Positioning,PrintSupport,Qml,QmlMeta,QmlModels,QmlWorkerScript,Quick,QuickWidgets,Svg,WebChannel,WebEngineCore,WebEngineWidgets,Widgets}.dll
Qt  _internal/PySide6/Qt/lib/libQt6{Core,DBus,EglFSDeviceIntegration,EglFsKmsSupport,Gui,Network,OpenGL,Pdf,Positioning,PrintSupport,Qml,QmlMeta,QmlModels,QmlWorkerScript,Quick,QuickWidgets,Svg,WaylandClient,WebChannel,WebEngineCore,WebEngineWidgets,Widgets,WlShellIntegration,XcbQpa}.so.6
# Plugins, by type; the input-method folder also holds the virtual keyboard.
Qt  _internal/PySide6/{plugins,Qt/plugins}/{egldeviceintegrations,generic,iconengines,imageformats,networkinformation,platforms,platformthemes,printsupport,styles,wayland-decoration-client,wayland-graphics-integration-client,wayland-shell-integration,xcbglintegrations}/*
Qt  _internal/PySide6/Qt/plugins/platforminputcontexts/lib{compose,ibus}platforminputcontextplugin.so
# WebEngine's helper process, and Mesa's software OpenGL for Windows
Qt  _internal/PySide6/{QtWebEngineProcess.exe,Qt/libexec/QtWebEngineProcess,opengl32sw.dll}
# Qt for Python: the bindings and their runtime
Qt  _internal/PySide6/{Qt*.pyd,Qt*.abi3.so,pyside6.abi3.dll,libpyside6.abi3.so.*}
Qt  _internal/shiboken6/{Shiboken.pyd,Shiboken.abi3.so,shiboken6.abi3.dll,libshiboken6.abi3.so.*}

# ICU, which Qt uses on Linux (from the PySide6 wheels)
ICU  _internal/PySide6/Qt/lib/libicu{data,i18n,uc}.so.73

# Microsoft's C and C++ runtime (Windows)
Microsoft  _internal/{,PySide6/,shiboken6/}{vcruntime140,vcruntime140_1,msvcp140,msvcp140_1,msvcp140_2,ucrtbase}.dll
Microsoft  _internal/api-ms-win-*.dll

# The Python runtime: interpreter, standard-library extension modules, and
# the OpenSSL and libffi of the Windows build
Python  _internal/{python3,python312}.dll
Python  _internal/libpython3.12.so.1.0
Python  _internal/*.pyd
Python  _internal/python3.12/lib-dynload/*.so
Python  _internal/{libcrypto-3,libssl-3,libffi-8}.dll

# Python packages, with the libraries their wheels include
NumPy  _internal/{numpy,numpy.libs}/**
SciPy  _internal/{scipy,scipy.libs}/**
PyYAML  _internal/yaml/*
